lastTreatment: row_data.lastTreatmentAt + claims_records.last_activity_at, written only by saveTreatmentUpdate / appendHistory after a significant action. Not on card open.
nextTreatment: row_data.nextDate required on active files. Not required when status is closed or archived.
reminders: Existing claims_reminders action=note. Idempotent id NT-{claimId}, purpose=next_treatment. Update in place. Cancel on close/archive/soft-delete.
archive: row_data.archived=true. Soft hide from active list. Restore clears flag. No new table.
delete: Soft delete via row_data.deletedAt. Requires typed מחק after warning. No hard delete.
qaAccident: Early locator bug marked two real 0014 tasks done. Reopened: פוליסה, השלמת מסמכים לפי הבקשה במייל. QA-* tasks left in place pending owner.
